concerns.why: Standalone @astralyn/pi packaging, identity, update source, and disabled install telemetry.

paths.rewrite: The first-run gate compares against this distribution's package metadata, replacing upstream's official-distribution constants.
The standalone package resolves bundled libraries from node_modules only, so upstream's monorepo workspace lookup is removed.
Repository source policy loads every grammar through static imports instead of upstream's deferred dynamic import.
Update checks read the npm registry, whose response replaces upstream's pi.dev payload fields.

concerns.why: The distribution's bundled extensions load as hidden built-ins.

Native Tasks supervision, retained output, persistence receipts, and extension-owned execution.

paths.rewrite: TaskSession owns result and usage persistence; TaskDelivery owns queued completion and tool-call receipts. Lifecycle pauses wrap upstream-shaped Body methods, and the native tasks tool is bound to the session.
Shell calls run through session supervision and the shared shell-execution pipeline, replacing upstream's inline execution path.
The task-usage ledger counts once per task, which turns upstream's accounting loop into a shared generator.
Footer totals read the shared accounted-usage ledger instead of summing session entries inline.
